summary: Tested Loans & EMIs feature - all backend APIs pass, all key frontend screens load and function correctly

ui_bugs.issue: Mark EMI button not labeled as 'Mark EMI Paid' - uses '+' icon in header instead. Minor UX issue.

integration_issues.issue: 3-dot menu uses React Native Alert.alert() / ActionSheet which renders as native browser dialog - not testable via Playwright. Menu options (View Details, Prepayment, Set Reminder, Transactions, Delete) could not be verified via automated testing, but are visible in code and routes work directly.

issues: Total Interest shows ₹63,60,000 which seems high - this is the calculated total interest over the entire 20-year loan term (₹32,750 × 240 months - ₹15,00,000 = ₹63,60,000). This is mathematically correct but may surprise users as it shows lifetime interest, not remaining interest.

action_items: 3-dot menu uses native Alert.alert - consider implementing a custom modal ActionSheet for better web compatibility and testability
critical_code_review_comments: loans.py: _serialize_loan doesn't handle case where start_date/next_emi_date is already a string (Firestore may return strings) - low risk but worth checking
add.tsx: The Save Loan button stays on the same URL if there's a 401 error and shows an Alert - error handling is correct but user sees no visual indication of auth state

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all screens load and work, 3-dot menu native dialog not testable)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 Home Loan (HDFC Bank, ₹15,00,000, 8.5%, ₹32,750 EMI, 20 years) during testing. Loan ID: loan_a3a73d295218

All 6 frontend screens (Dashboard, Add, Detail, Prepayment, Reminder, Transactions) tested and working. Backend APIs tested with single-user auth via /api/auth/single-user endpoint.
